newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-GRAF DUE TO MAKE COMEBACK AT GERMAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF DUE TO MAKE COMEBACK AT GERMAN OPEN.

text.p: World number one Steffi Graf, who has been out of action for over a month with a knee injury, is set to make a return to the court at the end of April in the German Open, organisers said on Friday.
The tournament may even provide an intriguing showdown with 16-year-old Martina Hingis of Switzerland who is due to take over the top spot held by Graf for a total of 377 weeks on March 31.
Graf, 27, has not played since the semifinals of a tournament in Tokyo on February 1 and has hardly trained since then.
Defending German Open champion Arantxa Sanchez Vicario, fellow Spaniard Conchita Martinez and Germany's Anke Huber will also take part in the tournament.
